maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Target Lock
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: You use technology or training to lock onto a target, granting advantage on your next attack against them.

effects.notes: Advantage on your next attack against the target

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Calculated Strike
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: You make a calculated strike, adding your Intelligence modifier to your next damage roll.

effects.notes: Add your Intelligence modifier to your next damage roll

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Feinting Attack
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: You feint to gain advantage and add your superiority die to the damage if the attack hits.

effects.notes: Advantage on your next attack
Add superiority die to damage if attack hits

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Trip Attack
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: On a hit, expend a superiority die to add to the damage and potentially knock the target prone.

effects.notes: Add superiority die to damage
Target must make Strength save or be knocked prone

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Disarming Blow
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: On a hit, expend a superiority die to add to the damage and attempt to disarm the target.

effects.notes: Add superiority die to damage
Target must make Strength save or drop a held object

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Emergency Shield
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Gain temporary HP when hit by an attack.

effects.notes: Gain 1d4 temporary hit points

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Parry
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a melee attack.

effects.notes: Reduce incoming melee damage by 1d4

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Riposte
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.

effects.notes: Make a melee attack against the creature that missed you

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Evasive Footwork
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: When you move, you can expend a superiority die to add the result to your AC until you stop moving.

effects.notes: Add superiority die to AC until you stop moving

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Guarded Stance
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Take a penalty to your melee attacks to gain a bonus to your melee defense.

effects.notes: Gain +2 AC but take -2 to melee attacks

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Reposition
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action.

effects.notes: Take Dash or Disengage action as bonus action

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Commander's Strike
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Forgo one of your attacks to allow an ally to use their reaction to make a weapon attack.

effects.notes: Ally can make a weapon attack as a reaction

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Rally
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Grant a friendly creature temporary hit points.

effects.notes: Grant 1d4 temporary hit points to ally

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Jury-Rig
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Perform a quick, temporary repair on a damaged object or droid.

effects.notes: Perform a temporary repair on an object or droid

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Analyze Weakness
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Make a Technology check to learn a target's vulnerabilities or resistances.

effects.notes: Learn target's vulnerabilities and resistances

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Evasive Maneuvers
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Take a defensive flying pattern. All attacks against the starship have disadvantage until your next turn.

effects.notes: All attacks against the starship have disadvantage

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Flyby
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Move up to your ship's speed. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

effects.notes: Movement does not provoke opportunity attacks

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Full Speed
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Take the Dash action with your starship.

effects.notes: Take Dash action with starship

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Fire Weapon
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Make an attack with one of the ship's weapon systems.

effects.notes: Make an attack with a starship weapon

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Wait for an Opening
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Hold your fire until an enemy ship becomes vulnerable. Your first attack next round is made with advantage.

effects.notes: Advantage on your first attack next round

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Target Engines
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Make an attack against a specific enemy ship system. If the attack hits, the target's speed is halved for one round in addition to normal damage.

effects.notes: Attack targets specific ship system
Target's speed is halved if attack hits

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Damage Control
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Make an Intelligence (Mechanics) check to repair a damaged system or restore a small number of hull points.

effects.notes: Repair a damaged system or restore hull points

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Boost Shields
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Reroute power to shields. Choose one shield facing (Forward, Aft, Port, or Starboard) to regenerate a number of shield points.

effects.notes: Regenerate 1d4 shield points on chosen facing

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Angle Deflector Shields
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: As a maneuver, you can redirect shield energy, increasing the defense of one facing at the expense of another.

effects.notes: Enhance one shield facing at the expense of another

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Encourage
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Grant an ally advantage on their next ability check or attack roll.

effects.notes: Ally gains advantage on next ability check or attack roll

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Target Priority
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Designate a single enemy vessel. All attacks made by your crew against that target gain a +1 bonus to their damage rolls until your next turn.

effects.notes: All crew attacks against designated target gain +1 damage

maneuvers_comprehensive.name: Squadron Command
maneuvers_comprehensive.description: Issue a command to an allied squadron, granting them a specific formation bonus as described in the FFG GM Kits.

effects.notes: Grant formation bonus to allied squadron
